lines.text: A driver's morning with AutoDock, run by our own agent framework.
The driver connects the car in the app. Our agent reads the battery, the range, the traffic and the free chargers, and holds pallet nine in Tower 2 for the arrival time.
Then just drive. Nothing to type, nothing to tap. The booking follows the car.
At the gate, a vision model reads the plate and matches it to the booking.
Tower 2 brings the held pallet down to the door.
Drive onto the pallet, and switch off.
Plug in. Charging starts at once, on cheaper rooftop solar while the sun is up.
Then walk away. Our agent watches the battery, the grid and the sun.
The pallet lifts the car into the tower, and frees the door for the next driver.
Full by ten past two, mostly on solar.
At pickup the car comes back down, and the bill is paid by UPI.
Book, drive, dock, charge, pay. Run by our agent, on Jev.
